_about: Anthropic list prices, USD per 1M tokens, for usage.py (REWRITE-4 Phase 0). Input, output and cache-read prices are the published first-party rates (claude-api skill table, cached 2026-10-06). Cache-write prices are NOT in that table: 'inferred' means 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour), the standard multipliers, so a cost figure is an estimate to within the cache-write share. Haiku 5.5 is priced for prompts up to 100K tokens (long prompts cost more). Model ids are matched after stripping a date suffix, longest prefix first. A model not listed here is counted in tokens but priced at $0 and flagged 'unpriced'. Check against the Anthropic console after real runs; Paul changes a price here only.
